harnessFindings.finding: The former secondary check treated the immutable July 18 historical capture as a current visual oracle.
The former repeatability path captured only once, truncated difference reporting, and did not lock an exact browser/environment boundary.
The runtime status surface had no exact approved-copy/structure reconciliation before pixel comparison.
No current failure was attributed to nondeterminism; two isolated current captures were pixel-identical in all 72 cells.
The original July 18 machine/browser/font/rendering stack is incompletely specified and cannot be recreated exactly.
